annotations.title: United Arab Emirates: full income tax return 2026

description: The complete United Arab Emirates income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: No personal income tax on employment, investment or rental income; ILOE unemployment insurance by basic pay (AED 5 or 10 a month); Emirati pension: Decree-Law 57 of 2023, Decree-Law 7 of 1999 and the Abu Dhabi Pension Fund, with the 2.5% state support; Corporate tax for a self-employed natural person above AED 1 million of turnover (9% above AED 375,000); VAT registration thresholds as a note; End-of-service gratuity under Article 51 of Decree-Law 33 of 2021. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in AED; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: A person's UAE position for 2026: the UAE has no personal income tax on salary, so this gives the contributions (ILOE, pension for Emiratis), corporate tax for a self-employed person above AED 1 million of turnover, and the end-of-service gratuity. Amounts are dirhams for the whole year; leave out what does not apply.

basic_pct.description: Basic pay as a percentage of total pay, which sets ILOE and gratuity. Default 60

iloe.description: Covered by ILOE unemployment insurance. Default true

salary.description: Gross yearly salary including allowances, UAE dirhams for 2026

years_of_service.description: Years of continuous service with this employer, for the gratuity

other_income.description: Investment and rental income (not taxed), UAE dirhams for 2026

status.description: expat (no pension scheme), national_federal (Emirati who joined the job market on or after 31 October 2023), national_1999 (Emirati insured under the 1999 law), national_abudhabi (Emirati in Abu Dhabi). Default expat

tax_paid.description: Corporate tax already paid for the year, UAE dirhams for 2026
